title: LinkerToOtzaria artifact record
description: One clickable citation link (source -> target ref), one per JSONL line. Authoritative format defined by src/linker_artifact.py.

book_key.description: Source book identity; matches the generator BookKey(sourceName, canonicalHeTitle) exactly.

line_index.description: 0-based index of the source line; equals line.lineIndex in the DB.

line_index_base.description: Base of line_index. Only 0 is supported.

start.description: Start offset of the citation span in the stored line content (line.content), HTML included.

end.description: Exclusive end offset; must be > start.

target_ref.description: Canonical English Sefaria ref (Ref.normal()), resolved to a line at build time.

source_path.description: Optional, debug only. Never authoritative for identity.

source_hash.description: Optional. content_hash() of the source line content the offsets index; the build drops the link if it no longer matches the current DB content (source-side drift guard).
